name: Left eye sector colour
summary: What colour the sector in this horse's left iris is, if it has one - a drawing model. Mid blue is dominant - the commonest sector is the blue wedge a white locus asks for, so the default is the colour that wedge already is - and green, gold, dark blue, brown, light blue and white each take a matched pair. Chaos is no real colour and is marked invalid (owner, 2026-10-15). No locus is published for sectoral heterochromia or its colour. Completely invisible on a horse whose sector locus is wild type, which is almost all of them.

phenotypes.name: Two different sector colours
phenotypes.description: Two different non-blue variants, which is a mid-blue sector. Each is recessive to the other.

phenotypes.name: Green sector
